description: Changes the settings of an automation set up from Cosend’s “Appointment reminder” recipe, named by id, as its settings page in Cosend does: the settings given replace their values, the rest keep theirs, and the result is saved as a new version. If the automation is switched on, the new settings go live with the save, or the save is refused in words and it keeps running what it ran; if it is off, they wait for it to be switched on. An automation from another recipe, or one written by hand, is refused. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the new version.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The automation set up from the “Appointment reminder” recipe whose settings change.

settings.description: The settings to change, as the recipe’s settings form asks them. A setting left out keeps the value it has.

calendar.description: The calendar whose bookings get these reminders. When none is chosen, every calendar on this number does. Put the customer's WhatsApp number in the event, in the title, the description, the location or as a guest, e.g. +41 79 123 45 67. Events without one get no reminder.

fallback_language.description: Sent when the customer’s own language isn’t one of the message’s approved languages. Left empty, the message’s first approved language.

quiet_hours.description: A reminder due at night waits until the night ends. A reminder that would then go after the appointment has started is not sent.
